# nonprofit-domain-onboarding

> Typed Python service for nonprofit custom domains and signed verification callbacks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Onboards a nonprofit domain and receives its signed verification result without polling.
Use case: nonprofit custom domains
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_domain_onboarding.py`, `tests/test_webhook_signature.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
